title: 第一卷 第21章 我活不活无所谓我只要你死第一卷 第22章 你不能杀我全家因为我是孤儿
content_zh:
说完这句话。
顾尘的身体突然颤抖了起来！
不是害怕。
也不是兴奋。
似是一直采取守势，被吴良的髓血震动之力刺激太过，这种颤抖由内而外，源自本能。
从骨骼到血肉，再到筋膜，再到皮肤……他只觉得身上像是有着万千蚂蚁在爬，想要把这种难受的感觉彻底宣泄掉。
一抬头！
他又是盯上了吴良，一步踏前，在地面上留下了个数寸深的脚印，一拳砸落而下！
很重很重！
砰的一声！
拳掌相交，吴良顿觉手臂发麻，身形一个不稳，竟是踉跄后退了数步！
“你……”
他看着顾尘，眼中满是惊疑，因为这是二人正面交锋以来，他第一次退，更因为这一拳的气力之大，远超过了他的想象！
锻体境巅峰。
抛开外物和神通秘法的加成不但，单靠体魄，最多能有千钧之力的爆发！
可——
顾尘这一拳，已然超过了千钧许多了！
“再来！”
刚想到这里，拳风骤起，顾尘的拳头又是砸了过来！
吴良心里一惊！

这一拳比之先前，竟是又是重了不少，又是让他后退了更远！
“还有！”
连出两拳，顾尘只觉得那种难受的感觉减少了很多，这让他宣泄的念头越发强烈，一步步踏前，一拳拳挥出，逼得吴良一退再退！
“砰——！”
“砰——！”
“……”
一拳接一拳，一拳比一拳气力大，直至第十拳落下，吴良已然退了十丈，两条手臂都麻了！
拳势一顿！
顾尘的身形也随之停了下来，只觉得通体酣畅，那种难受的感觉已然消失无踪！
悄无声息间。
他周身的毛孔内突然涌出了大量的汗水，汗水之中，更夹杂着诸多散发着腥臭味的杂质！
“你……”
吴良瞳孔又是一缩！
顾尘竟是又破境……不！严格来说，这并非破境，而是——
“锻体！圆满？”
吴良惊呼出声，声音里带着惊骇和难以置信。
诸般境界。
自有初，中，后，巅峰，乃至于圆满之分。
只是相比前四者，圆满之境与其说是一个小境界，不如说是将某个境界打磨修炼到极致的特殊表现，并不是修行中必须要迈过的关卡。
事实上。
content_en:
Finish this sentence.
Gu Chen's body suddenly started to tremble!
Not afraid.
Not excited either.
It seemed that he had been on the defensive and was overly stimulated by the vibrating power of Wu Liang's marrow blood. This tremor came from the inside out and came from instinct.
From bones to flesh and blood, to fascia, to skin... He just felt like there were thousands of ants crawling on his body, and he wanted to completely vent this uncomfortable feeling.
Look up!
He stared at Wu Liang again, stepped forward, leaving a few inches deep footprints on the ground, and punched him down!
Very heavy!
Bang!
As their fists and palms met, Wu Liang felt his arms go numb, his body became unstable, and he staggered back a few steps!
"You..."
He looked at Gu Chen, his eyes full of surprise, because this was the first time he had retreated since the two of them faced off, and because the power of this punch was far beyond his imagination!
The peak of the body training realm.
Putting aside the bonuses from foreign objects and magical powers, not only physical strength alone can produce an explosion of at most a huge amount of power!
But——
Gu Chen's punch was already much stronger than Qianjun!
"Come again!"
Just when he thought of this, the wind of fists suddenly rose, and Gu Chen's fist hit again!
Wu Liang was shocked!
This punch was much heavier than before, and it made him retreat further!
"More!"
After throwing two punches in a row, Gu Chen only felt that the uncomfortable feeling was reduced a lot, which made him want to vent more and more intensely. He stepped forward step by step and punched out, forcing Wu Liang to retreat again and again!
"Bang——!"
"Bang——!"
"..."
Punch after punch, each punch was more powerful than the last, until the tenth punch landed, Wu Liang had already retreated ten feet, and both arms were numb!
A punch!
Gu Chen's figure also stopped, and he felt that his whole body was relaxed and the uncomfortable feeling had disappeared!
Quietly.
A large amount of sweat suddenly burst out from the pores all over his body, and the sweat was mixed with many impurities that exuded a fishy smell!
"You..."
Wu Liang's pupils shrank again!
Gu Chen actually broke through again... No! Strictly speaking, this is not a breakthrough, but——
"Body training! Consummation?"
Wu Liang exclaimed, with horror and disbelief in his voice.
All kinds of realms.
It can be divided into beginning, middle, end, peak, and even perfection.
But compared with the first four, the state of perfection is not so much a small state, but a special manifestation of polishing and cultivating a certain state to the extreme. It is not a level that must be passed in practice.
In fact.
